_comment: The single-colony screen (wire id 1), work order 180 B. Geometry is screens/colony/colgeom.py (transcribed); the wording here is ours where the original's is baked into its art (decision 15), and the marks name every difference from the original, each held by check 090p and named in dev:v3_projektstatus.md.

words._note: DEVIATION `button_words`: the original's four buttons carry their words in COLPUPS.LBX art (colony_main.cpp:991-1012); HD draws the art as HUD buttons and the words in code, the Races screen's rule. 'marines' and 'armour' name the two unit counts the strip draws beside the original's sprites (military[0], military[1], colony_main.cpp:1193-1293).

marks.transcription_scene: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 223) — the original's picture of the world: COLONY2.LBX 0x31's sky with PLANETS.LBX's ground (climate x 3 + the planet's climate_bg_type) over it, in FONTS.LBX 2 with the ground's palette (colony_main.cpp:111-115, :475-479; colony.cpp:230-233), extracted by tools/colony_art_extract.py and drawn native pixel to its HD rectangle.
marks.transcription_system_pictures: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 223) — the system display's planets as COLSYSDI.LBX draws them: by the colony's climate and the planet's size, a gas giant, an asteroid belt, and each orbit's marker (colsysdi.cpp:4-48).
marks.hd_extension_surface_picture: Data's picture of the colony's world, by climate (decision 58, the Colonies screen's colonysurfaces), only where the original's pictures are not extracted. Absent pictures draw nothing.
marks.deviation_label_number: A production row is its icon and the original's own net as a number (colonyrows.drawn_production, coldraw.cpp:36-181), morale its mask and the halved value; the original COUNTS with sprites (Draw_Colony_Prod_Both_, Draw_Info_Morale_Both_). Decision 56's deviation, the Colonies screen's. A job row draws each pop's figure in the original's icon order, squeezed into the row.
marks.deviation_building_list: The colony's buildings are a list of names in a panel; the original draws each building's picture on its cell of the scene.
marks.deviation_change_by_field: CHANGE is sent as its FIELD [4], never as the key C: [5] (recalculate, and Do_Cheats_ with _cheats) is built first with the same hotkey and a key resolves to the first match (fields.cpp:2608-2613). Decision 39's key-first order does not apply to a shadowed key.
marks.deviation_hd_font: Text in the HD font at a size from the native line pitch, fitted to the original's width (the Leaders screen's rule).
marks.omission_officer_portrait: The officer's portrait and frame (C_Anims_ 30, 33, colony.cpp:714-717) are not drawn; the name or the ETA is.
marks.omission_roads: The roads between buildings (Draw_Road_List_, colony_main.cpp:117) follow the placement and the original's art; not drawn.
marks.omission_hover_strip: The original names what its own pointer is over (Print_Scanned_String_, colony.cpp:807-816); HD shows refusal messages there and nothing else yet.
marks.omission_building_actions: A building's demolish confirmation is routed by the REAL pointer's polygon (colony.cpp:1932-1986): an ACTIVATE_FIELD is swallowed or lands on whatever building the pointer is over. Not offered. (Its description box is: TRANSCRIPTION building_info, work order 200.)
marks.omission_galaxy_inset: The galaxy-map inset (_drawing_display 1) is unreachable in orion2re ([9]/[10] are -1000 for ever, colony_main.cpp:981-982) and not built.
marks.transcription_carry: Work order 233: a click on a figure takes it and every identical colonist after it in the colony's array (Pickup_Colonists_ -> COLMOVE::Get_Cluster_, colony.cpp:1508-1517, :1621-1626; colmove.cpp:60-100); they leave their row (0x200, coldraw.cpp:336) and ride on the pointer as Draw_Cluster_ draws them, last, over everything (colony_main.cpp:178-182; colmove.cpp:24-55). HD holds them itself until the drop (decision 47, core/carry.py, the Races screen's gesture) and from the drop on draws what the command expects until the wire has it.
marks.transcription_put_back: Work order 233: the original's ways out of a carry, and only those: a drop on the colonists' own row re-flags them (Send_Cluster_, colmove.cpp:182-183); leaving the screen (RETURN, ESC, LEADERS, CHANGE, < >) puts them back (Reset_Field_Mode_ -> Clear_Cluster_, colony.cpp:1108-1123). Every other click does what it does and they stay in hand; a right click is help (F913). Replaces work order 180's HD EXTENSION pick_cancel (ESC, a right click or a click elsewhere released the pick).
marks.transcription_settle: Work order 233, open fix 92: colonists in hand dropped on a planet of the system display go to that planet's colony (Send_Cluster_(colony, -1), colony.cpp:1796-1800; SETTLER::Pop_Tries_To_Settle_ / Settle_Pop_, settler.cpp:234-343), as ONE command the engine applies whole or not at all (MSG_SETTLE_POPS, screens/colony/colsettle.py); the refusals HD can read are answered before sending with the game's own sentences.
marks.deviation_carry_production: Work order 233: while colonists are in hand the original's production rows count without them (Pickup_Colonists_ recalculates, colony.cpp:1625); HD holds them itself (decision 47) and its rows show the colony as the wire has it until the drop.
marks.transcription_settle_count: Work order 315: Send_Cluster_ asks for each colonist in hand in turn and moves every one it may (colmove.cpp:177-197, :475); HD sends those (colsettle.settle_count: the source keeps its last pop, settler.cpp:269-272; the target takes them while it has room, :296-297), the rest stay in hand (colmove.cpp:528-531) with the original's sentence and the number sent (E 0xFD / 0x241, E 0x80).
marks.unverified_building_placement: Open fix 36's grid is parsed and its occupied cells land on the live building fields (verified), but what a cell's id means for the scene is not settled: Make_Bldg_Array_For_Colony_ also puts housing (-3) in the grid and jitters satellites into it (colony_main.cpp:559-600), and the recorded grids name Star Base and Star Fortress twice where the native scene shows each once. Nothing is placed from it until that is read and seen.
marks.deviation_production_bar: The production bar is drawn, not the original's art: C_Anims_ 34/35 at frames 0..50 over a 64 native px column from (606, 53) (coldraw.cpp:249-280). HD fills that column current/total; the art's width is not in the source, HD's is 12 native px.
marks.transcription_planet_description: Work order 315 (seen live; until then marked OMISSION): a click on a system-display summary is the game's own field; the original goes to _drawing_display 2 and shows that planet's description in its box (colony.cpp:1825-1830, :1861-1866), which HD shows as its message box.
marks.transcription_building_info: TRANSCRIPTION — a right click on a row of HD's building list sends the right click to that building's own field (its open fix 36 cell, or its satellite slot, colony.cpp:1713-1758), and the game's description box (Text_Box_, colony.cpp:1608-1613, :1988-2010) comes back as HD's message box (screens/colony/colright.py, core/rightinfo.py). Work order 200.
marks.transcription_unit_figures: Work order 226 G: the units at the screen's foot are the original's figures (RACEICON race*13+figure+6, Military_Anim_ colony.cpp:1308-1328), laid out as Do_Colony_Info_Military_Stuff_For_ lays them (colony_main.cpp:1193-1290): one each up to eight, else one per kind and its count (E 0x7C).
marks.transcription_product_room: Work order 226 G: the build window's grid room (COLPUPS.LBX 5, the band's art) with the product standing in it where Draw_Info_Build_ draws it (colony_main.cpp:899-945); screens/colony/colroom.py, the build popup's code.
marks.deviation_row_cells: Work order 226 G: the production rows, morale and the job rows are ruled cells drawn with the shell's outline where the original's band art rules them; a job row's cell is its field (decision 5).
marks.deviation_one_top: Work order 226 G, 231, 232: the band's four boxes share one top and height, the original's band from its first row of content (24..158, colgeom.BAND_TOP); the original's art boxes start at 17, 24 and 29.
marks.deviation_officer_slot: Work order 232: with an officer at the star the original adds no LEADERS button; field [17] is a hidden field over the officer's frame (colony_main.cpp:994-999). HD's LEADERS slot sends that field and carries the officer's name or ETA as its word, where the original shows his portrait in a frame with the name under it.
marks.hd_extension_surface_format_picture: Work order 232: a picture in the surface panel's own format (screens/colony/assets/surfaces/<climate>.png or <climate>_<ground>.png, screens/colony/colsurface.py) wins over the original's 640 x 328 picture; the original has no route to replace it.
marks.transcription_transport_button: Work order 316: while colonists are in hand the original adds its button at (307, 159) ([11], C_Anims_ 24; colony.cpp:1771-1781), which opens the transport popup (colony_main.cpp:1068-1076); HD draws it as a shell button at the surface panel's top, its left edge at 307 of the 640 columns (screens/colony/coltransfer.py). Replaces work order 233's OMISSION transport_button.
marks.transcription_transport_popup: Work order 316: COLXPORT::Xport_Popup_ (colxport.cpp:91-309): the player's colonies that are not outposts in array order, six rows at a time, the name red where the star is blockaded, every pop in one strip, the arrows stepping by one, a row answering its colony (Send_Cluster_(colony, -1), colony_main.cpp:1072) and cancel keeping the colonists in hand (screens/colony/colxport.py).
marks.deviation_transport_popup_hud: Work order 316: the HUD look (decision 71) in place of COLPUPS.LBX 0x10's art at the screen's top left: a lit popup centred on the screen, the two column heads and CANCEL typed here (transport), the arrows as triangles, the thumb as a bar.
marks.omission_transport_plague_red: Work order 316: the original reddens a row's name for the plague too; the wire carries the plague of the colony on screen only (CEVT), so HD reddens for a blockade alone.
marks.hd_extension_transport_escape: Work order 316: ESC closes the transport popup as its cancel does; the original's loop ends on its cancel field or a row alone (colxport.cpp:164).
marks.hd_extension_transport_row_hover: Work order 316: the row under the pointer is drawn as the HUD's selected row; the original marks nothing over its hidden fields.
marks.transcription_transfer_walk: Work order 316, open fix 103: Send_Cluster_ to another colony walked colonist by colonist as Pop_Tries_To_Settle_ decides (settler.cpp:230-311; colmove.cpp:145-531): the refusals, the freighters (five each), 25 in transit, the room with the settlers already heading there, the ETA (screens/colony/colxfer.py, a forecast the engine's STLR outcome overrides).
marks.transcription_transfer_boxes: Work order 316, open fix 103: the original's questions (E 0x209; 0x205 / 0x203; 0x206 / 0x204) answered before the command, its "Settlers Failed." box naming why and how many went (E 0x1D6, colmove.cpp:302-379, :390-468) and its "Settlers Depart" box (E 0x1D5 / 0x1D1, :482-522) after it, in HD's message box (screens/colony/colxferflow.py). Replaces DEVIATIONs settle_past_limit, settle_refusal_line and settle_notice.
marks.deviation_settle_without_fix103: Work order 316: on an engine with open fix 92 alone (no STLR) the colony screen keeps work order 233's and 315's move: a colony at the star only, as many as go without a question, the rest in hand with the sentence on the message line and no notice box; no TRANSPORT button.

transport._note: DEVIATION `transport_popup_hud`: the words COLPUPS.LBX 0x10 carries in its art (work order 316).
transport.name: COLONY NAME
